ModMetaData.name: RimSynapse - Conversations
ModMetaData.author: RimSynapse Team
ModMetaData.description:
Discord Community: https://discord.gg/eVBebZ2N9s Version: v0.9.1 (Target: RimWorld 1.6)
RimSynapse - Conversations Official Wiki and Documentation: https://github.com/RimSynapse/Conversations/wiki Source: https://github.com/RimSynapse/Conversations Steam Workshop: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3768363934
Companion Mod for RimSynapse. Colonists hold dynamic, memory-aware, trait-influenced conversations written by a Large Language Model - now grounded in concrete beats so they talk about real events, chores and needs instead of generic filler, with warden work (recruiting, converting, enslaving and suppressing prisoners) played out as spoken exchanges.
If you enjoy the RimSynapse suite, you can support development at https://ko-fi.com/archdukejim
--- Roadmap --- Conversations tracks its own release milestones. What ships next is scoped to dialogue features in this mod - see other RimSynapse mods for their own roadmaps. 0.10 - Expansion Dialects: activate the DLC-specific flavours listed in the compatibility matrix - noble tone demands and psycast interjections (Royalty), faith debates and conversion attempts (Ideology), xenotype dialects and mechanitor comm chatter (Biotech), void whispers (Anomaly). Backlog: group conversations (three-way and small-group dialogue with turn-taking and reactions from listeners in earshot), player-to-pawn direct dialogue, more Universe Actions (relationship shifts, inspire-to-job), and additional environmental / event triggers. These ship when they are ready - no dates.
--- Changelog (v0.9.1) - Linked Memories --- - Fixed: chit-chat and overheard-conversation memories now record who they are about through Core 0.9's canonical memory linkage, so a conversation about a colonist truly consolidates with later events about them (their death, most importantly). Previously these memories were invisible to relational consolidation. - Requires RimSynapse Core v0.9.0.
--- Changelog (v0.9.0) - Factions and Living Societies --- - NEW - Warden conversations: recruiting, converting, enslaving and suppressing a prisoner now play out as spoken exchanges grounded in that prisoner's real situation - their resistance, will, comfort, how they were captured, and (with Ideology) the belief clash. Persuasion can build a little rapport; coercion never does. Flavour only - it never changes the vanilla recruitment or conversion roll. - IMPROVED - Dialogue quality overhaul: before the model writes a line, an in-code agent now picks one concrete beat - a real event, chore or need, and each speaker's angle on it - so colonists talk about actual specifics instead of interchangeable filler. Trust, familiarity and opinion shifts are computed in code for consistency. - NEW - Load-adaptive conversations: when the AI can't keep up (a big colony, a slower model, or high game speed), conversations quietly stop generating instead of piling up a backlog - relationships still evolve, you just don't pay for dialogue you can't watch. Speech bubbles still appear at normal speed. - CHANGED - The player-to-storyteller chat window has moved to RimSynapse Core. Conversations now owns pawn-to-pawn dialogue only. - Requires Core v0.9.0; saves and settings carry over unchanged.
Full version history: https://github.com/RimSynapse/Conversations/wiki/Changelog
--- Compatibility Matrix --- - Royalty DLC: Compatible and Optional. Enables noble tone demands and psycast interjections. - Ideology DLC: Compatible and Optional. Enables faith debates and active proselytizing. - Biotech DLC: Compatible and Optional. Enables xenotype dialects and mechanitor comms. - Anomaly DLC: Compatible and Optional. Enables paranoid void whispers. - RimSynapse - Psychology: Compatible and Optional. Colonists will naturally bring up their deep core memories, traumas, and trust levels during everyday conversations.
--- Requirements --- - RimSynapse - Core (Must be loaded before this mod)
